articles.title: Transcriptome profiling of human hypothalamic agouti-related protein and proopiomelanocortin neurons regulating energy homeostasis
articles.abstract: Abstract We present and validate a pioneering ‘IHC/LCM-Seq’ method for transcriptome profiling of spatially defined neuronal cell types detected with immunohistochemistry in sections of formaldehyde-fixed human brains. Application of IHC/LCM-Seq to male human hypothalami enables the identification of 14,000–16,000 transcripts in agouti-related protein (AgRP) neurons, which drive appetite and energy storage, and proopiomelanocortin (POMC) neurons, which suppress feeding and promote energy expenditure. These cell types differ from each other, and from fertility-regulating kisspeptin neurons, in their distinct enrichments of co-transmitters, transcription factors, regulatory (lnc) RNAs and receptors. The AgRP neuron transcriptome is rich in receptors for proinflammatory cytokines, metabolic hormones and growth hormone, whereas POMC neurons express reproductive hormone-, glucagon-like peptide-, calcitonin-, and endocannabinoid receptors. IHC/LCM-Seq, a versatile spatial transcriptomic approach for characterizing cell types in postmortem human brain tissue, opens a new window onto the molecular mechanisms that regulate energy homeostasis and highlights potential pharmacological targets for weight-management strategies.

articles.title:
Exploiting Omic
Data to Advance Predictive Ecotoxicology
articles.abstract: Abstract Predicting species-specific chemical sensitivity using in silico approaches has the potential to transform environmental risk assessment, conservation, and biomonitoring, while reducing, and ultimately replacing, animal testing. Genomic and transcriptomic data capture extensive sensitivity-relevant variation, including differences in molecular targets, xenobiotic metabolism, and damage mitigation pathways. Large-scale sequencing initiatives therefore offer an unprecedented opportunity to address ecotoxicology’s “too many species” problem. Although existing omic-based predictive tools provide proof of concept, they have so far been applied to a narrow set of relatively straightforward prediction scenarios. To achieve broader applicability, current and future tools must be firmly grounded in the diverse molecular mechanisms underlying differential chemical responses. Here, we critically evaluate the emerging field of predicting species sensitivity using molecular variation inferred from omic data. We analyze the strengths and limitations of current omic-based approaches and identify major sequence and ecotoxicological data gaps, as well as critical bioinformatic challenges. We then review the current knowledge of how molecular biology underlies differential chemical sensitivity, outlining research paths to allow the next generation of sensitivity prediction tools to exploit ever expanding omic data.

articles.title: Dual-additive enabled inorganic-rich solid electrolyte interphase for high-rate lithium negative electrodes
articles.abstract: Abstract Constructing a robust, highly conductive solid electrolyte interphase is the key to unlock the high-rate potential of lithium negative electrodes for broad applications. Here we propose a simple yet effective strategy, by introducing a sulfur-containing compound and LiNO 3 as dual additives into a conventional carbonate electrolyte. As an example, 3-sulfolene is found to enhance the dissolution of LiNO 3 , and it works with NO 3 − to regulate the Li + -solvation structure and facilitate the formation of a robust while uniform solid electrolyte interphase rich in Li 3 N/Li 2 S/Li 2 O inorganics, enabling rapid Li + transfer and high interfacial stability. Consequently, Li | |LiFePO 4 cells achieve 81.7% capacity retention after 6,000 cycles at 80 C, while Li | |LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 cells maintain 81.3% capacity after 500 cycles at 10 C. Moreover, two pouch cells with specific energy exceeding 500 Wh kg −1 (calculated based on total mass of the pouch cells) retain 92.1% and 91.8% of initial capacities after 143 and 149 cycles (charged at 0.1 C and discharged at 0.3 C), respectively. This work provides a general dual-additive strategy to promote the formation of an inorganic-rich solid electrolyte interphase for high-rate lithium negative electrodes.
articles.title_zh: 用于高倍率锂负极的双添加剂富无机固体电解质界面
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 构建坚固、高导电性的固体电解质界面是释放锂负极高倍率潜力并得到广泛应用的关键。在这里，我们提出了一种简单而有效的策略，将含硫化合物和LiNO 3 作为双重添加剂引入到传统的碳酸盐电解液中。例如，3-环丁砜被发现可以增强LiNO 3 的溶解，并与NO 3 - 一起调节Li + 溶剂化结构，促进形成坚固而均匀的富含Li 3 N/Li 2 S/Li 2 O无机物的固体电解质界面，从而实现快速的Li + 转移和高界面稳定性。因此，李| |LiFePO 4 电池在 80 C 下循环 6,000 次后容量保持率达到 81.7%，而 Li | |LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 电池在 10 C 下循环 500 次后仍保持 81.3% 的容量。此外，比能量超过 500 Wh kg -1 （基于软包电池总质量计算）的两种软包电池在 143 次和 149 次循环（0.1 C 充电和0.3 C），分别。这项工作提供了一种通用的双添加剂策略，以促进高倍率锂负极富含无机固体电解质界面的形成。

articles.title: Selective filtering of multi-photon events from a single-photon emitter
articles.abstract: Abstract Single-photon purity is one of the most important key metrics of many quantum states of light. For applications in photonic quantum technologies, e.g. quantum communication and linear optical quantum computing, a minimization of the multi-photon error rate is required because of its error-introducing nature. Ultimately, the purity of state-of-the-art single-photon sources was found to be limited by spontaneous emission and subsequent reexcitation during the interaction with the driving field. Here, we demonstrate that even this fundamental limit to the single-photon purity can be overcome due to the distinct spectro-temporal properties of the individual photons forming multi-photon errors. For driving pulses shorter than the emitter lifetime, we find that photons emitted during the pulse exhibit a significantly broader spectral shape than the emitter’s natural linewidth. Thus, we can selectively filter out the majority of this instantaneously emitted photon by employing narrowband spectral filters, which reduces the measured degree of second-order coherence at zero time delay by almost one order of magnitude. This enables a significant suppression of the multi-photon error rate without detrimental effects on the desired single-photon emission.
articles.title_zh: 对来自单光子发射器的多光子事件进行选择性过滤
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 单光子纯度是许多光量子态最重要的关键指标之一。适用于光子量子技术的应用，例如在量子通信和线性光量子计算中，由于其引入错误的性质，需要最小化多光子错误率。最终，人们发现最先进的单光子源的纯度受到自发发射和随后与驱动场相互作用期间的再激发的限制。在这里，我们证明，由于形成多光子误差的单个光子的独特光谱时间特性，即使是单光子纯度的这一基本限制也可以被克服。对于短于发射器寿命的驱动脉冲，我们发现脉冲期间发射的光子表现出比发射器自然线宽明显更宽的光谱形状。因此，我们可以通过采用窄带光谱滤波器选择性地滤除大部分瞬时发射的光子，这将零时延下测量的二阶相干度降低了几乎一个数量级。这能够显着抑制多光子错误率，而不会对所需的单光子发射产生不利影响。

articles.title: Orientational enhancement of surface phonon polarity in superconducting KTaO₃ interfaces
articles.abstract: Abstract The critical role of symmetry-breaking interfaces in mediating superconductivity has garnered increasing interest in recent years. KTaO 3 (KTO)-based heterointerfaces present a striking example, where the superconducting transition temperature ( T c ) exhibits an intriguing dependence on KTO crystallographic orientation. Here we identify a highly anisotropic surface phonon resonance near 107 meV at KTO and KTO-based heterointerfaces using surface-specific, symmetry-sensitive nonlinear optical spectroscopy. Polarity of this phonon mode scales with crystallographic orientation as (111) > (110) ≫ (001), reaching a 35-fold enhancement over non-superconducting interfaces and tracking the superconducting T c . In addition, a softened local mode near 100 meV is observed and attributed to interfacial oxygen vacancies. Our results help build a framework linking the symmetry-breaking lattice phonons, defects, and anisotropic superconductivity for KTO and related heterointerfaces.
articles.title_zh: 超导KTaO₃界面表面声子极性的定向增强
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 近年来，对称性破缺界面在介导超导性中的关键作用引起了越来越多的关注。基于 KTaO 3 (KTO) 的异质界面是一个引人注目的例子，其中超导转变温度 ( T c ) 表现出对 KTO 晶体取向的有趣依赖性。在这里，我们使用表面特异性、对称敏感的非线性光谱在 KTO 和基于 KTO 的异质界面处识别出接近 107 meV 的高度各向异性表面声子共振。该声子模式的极性与晶体取向成比例(111) > (110) ≫ (001)，达到非超导界面的 35 倍增强，并跟踪超导 T c 。此外，还观察到了 100 meV 附近的软化局部模式，并将其归因于界面氧空位。我们的结果有助于建立一个将 KTO 和相关异质界面的对称破缺晶格声子、缺陷和各向异性超导性联系起来的框架。

articles.title: Unraveling the coastal marine plastisphere archaeome
articles.abstract: Abstract Plastic pollution has created an expanding anthropogenic microbial niche, the plastisphere, raising questions about microbial ecology and associated impacts. Archaea, the third domain of life with fundamental ecological and evolutionary significance, remain poorly understood in this habitat. Here, using paired plastic debris and bulk-water samples from coastal marine ecosystems, key archaeal habitats increasingly threatened by plastic pollution, we characterize the plastisphere archaeome through archaeal amplicon sequencing and metagenomics. We show that the archaeome is significantly reshaped in the plastisphere, exhibiting higher taxonomic diversity, greater community heterogeneity, and selective enrichment of Euryarchaeota and Crenarchaeota. Archaeal genes involved in methane, nitrogen, and sulfur cycling are enriched in the plastisphere. Taxonomic and functional divergence between the plastisphere and bulk water increases with anthropogenic chemical stress. These findings suggest that plastic pollution could alter marine archaeal diversity, biogeography, and biogeochemical potential, extending understanding of plastisphere impacts to the archaeal domain.
articles.title_zh: 解开沿海海洋塑料球古菌组
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 塑料污染创造了一个不断扩大的人为微生物生态位，即塑料圈，引发了有关微生物生态学和相关影响的问题。古细菌是具有基本生态和进化意义的第三个生命领域，但人们对该栖息地的了解仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们使用来自沿海海洋生态系统（日益受到塑料污染威胁的关键古菌栖息地）的配对塑料碎片和大量水样本，通过古菌扩增子测序和宏基因组学来表征塑料球古菌组。我们发现古菌组在塑料圈中显着重塑，表现出更高的分类多样性、更大的群落异质性以及广古菌门和泉古菌门的选择性富集。参与甲烷、氮和硫循环的古菌基因在塑料圈中富集。塑料圈和散装水之间的分类和功能差异随着人为化学压力的增加而增加。这些发现表明，塑料污染可能会改变海洋古菌多样性、生物地理学和生物地球化学潜力，从而将塑料圈影响的理解扩展到古菌领域。

articles.title:
Revealing Hidden
Evaporative Emissions: A Streamlined
Method for Distinguishing Canister and Non-Canister Sources
articles.abstract: Abstract As tailpipe standards tighten, evaporative emissions have become a major VOC source. Current whole-vehicle regulations overlook the distinct contributions of canister bleed versus non-canister emissions, hindering accurate assessment and control. We developed a synchronized method coupling mini- and variable-temperature SHED to separately measure both sources during diurnal tests. Testing China 6 vehicles under the standard certification protocol, non-canister emissions averaged 170.3 ± 49.1 mg/day, while canister emissions averaged only 3.2 ± 1.2 mg/day, a ratio of ∼59:1. Across test conditions, non-canister emissions exceeded canister emissions by ∼19-fold on average. Canister emissions were highly condition-dependent, reaching 18 times the baseline under off-cycle conditions, with VOC composition shifting toward more reactive species (alkenes, aromatics) and ozone formation potential rising to nearly 600% of certification levels. In contrast, non-canister emissions remained stable in both composition and magnitude. These findings support a shift from mass-based whole-vehicle limits to differentiated, species-resolved strategies. Our streamlined method enables separate yet simultaneous testing of both source types, offering a practical approach for next-stage evaporative standards and progress toward near-zero emissions.

articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 随着尾气标准的收紧，蒸发排放已成为主要的VOC来源。目前的整车法规忽视了碳罐排放与非碳罐排放的独特贡献，阻碍了准确的评估和控制。我们开发了一种同步方法，将微型和变温 SHED 结合起来，在昼夜测试期间分别测量这两个源。根据标准认证协议对国6车辆进行测试，非滤毒罐排放平均为170.3±49.1毫克/天，而滤毒罐排放平均仅为3.2±1.2毫克/天，比例约为59:1。在整个测试条件下，非碳罐排放量平均比碳罐排放量高出约 19 倍。碳罐排放量高度依赖于条件，在非循环条件下达到基线的 18 倍，VOC 成分转向更具活性的物质（烯烃、芳烃），臭氧形成潜力上升到认证水平的近 600%。相比之下，非碳罐排放在成分和数量上保持稳定。这些发现支持从基于质量的整车限制转向差异化的、物种解决的策略。我们简化的方法可以对两种源类型进行单独但同时的测试，为下一阶段的蒸发标准和接近零排放的进展提供了实用的方法。

articles.title:
Interfacial Enrichment
of Microplastics at Microdroplet
Air–Water Interface Facilitates Photoaging
articles.abstract: Abstract Microplastics (MPs) pollution has become a critical global environmental issue, posing potential threats to aquatic ecosystems and human health. However, existing studies on MPs photoaging have largely focused on bulk systems, while the role of microdroplet environments in natural processes (e.g., wave breaking and aerosol formation) remains underexplored. The role of the air–water interface (AWI) of microdroplets in regulating MPs photoaging was investigated. By comparing polystyrene (PS), polyethylene terephthalate (PET), and polycaprolactone (PCL) in microdroplet and bulk systems, microdroplets significantly enhance MPs-derived dissolved organic matter (MP-DOM) release, reaching 2.60–3.35 times that of the bulk phase (248.26 mg C/L in the microdroplet system and 74.17 mg C/L in the bulk system at 96 h), while altering the evolution of surface functional groups. Mechanistic analysis revealed that interfacial enrichment of MPs and a strong electric field together sustain higher steady-state concentrations of reactive oxygen species (ROS), particularly hydroxyl radicals. Molecular-level analysis shows that polystyrene-derived dissolved organic matter (PS-DOM) in microdroplets exhibits higher aromaticity, greater oxidation, and enhanced electron transfer capacity (dominated by electron-accepting). Highly oxidized PS-DOM can promote oxidation and drive a self-amplifying radical cycle, thereby continuously accelerating MPs photoaging. This study elucidates microdroplet regulation of MPs degradation and provides new insights into the fate of MPs in heterogeneous aquatic environments.
articles.title_zh:
界面富集
Microdroplet 的微塑料
空气-水界面促进光老化
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 微塑料（MPs）污染已成为全球重要的环境问题，对水生生态系统和人类健康构成潜在威胁。然而，现有的 MP 光老化研究主要集中在本体系统，而微滴环境在自然过程（例如波浪破碎和气溶胶形成）中的作用仍未得到充分探索。研究了微滴的空气-水界面（AWI）在调节 MPs 光老化中的作用。通过比较微滴和本体系统中的聚苯乙烯 (PS)、聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯 (PET) 和聚己内酯 (PCL)，微滴显着增强了 MP 衍生的溶解有机物 (MP-DOM) 的释放，达到本体相的 2.60–3.35 倍（96 小时时微滴系统中为 248.26 mg C/L，本体系统中为 74.17 mg C/L），同时改变了表面的演变功能组。机理分析表明，MP 的界面富集和强电场共同维持了活性氧 (ROS)，特别是羟基自由基的较高稳态浓度。分子水平分析表明，微滴中的聚苯乙烯衍生的溶解有机物（PS-DOM）表现出更高的芳香性、更强的氧化性和增强的电子传递能力（以电子接受为主）。高度氧化的PS-DOM可以促进氧化并驱动自放大自由基循环，从而不断加速MPs光老化。这项研究阐明了 MP 降解的微滴调节，并为 MP 在异质水生环境中的命运提供了新的见解。

articles.title: Toluene Unexpectedly Promotes Low-Temperature NO x Reduction by Inducing Peroxide Oxygen on Ce–Ti Catalysts
articles.abstract: Abstract Volatile organic compounds (VOCs) are widely considered to inhibit NH3–SCR by competing with NH3 for surface sites and blocking redox centers, yet industrial flue gases frequently contain both VOCs and NOx. Here we show that toluene unexpectedly promotes low-temperature DeNOx over Ce–Ti catalysts, with the hollow nanotube-structured CeTiNTs exhibiting outstanding performance, achieving >90% conversion of both NOx and toluene at 200 °C with high CO2 selectivity and near-unity N2 selectivity. Mechanistically, toluene acts as an electron donor to surface Ce sites, increasing the Ce3+ fraction and oxygen-vacancy-associated adsorbed oxygen. In situ near-ambient-pressure XPS and Raman spectroscopy reveal the toluene-triggered formation of surface peroxide (O22–), which accelerates NO oxidation to NO2 and thus initiates the fast-SCR pathway, while simultaneously enabling deep oxidation of toluene. Density functional theory corroborates preferential adsorption of toluene on Ce sites and reduced oxygen-vacancy formation energies at specific lattice positions. These results establish a reaction-coupling route in which toluene exhibits dual effects, involving competitive adsorption that partially inhibits certain NH3–SCR steps, while predominantly promoting low-temperature fast-SCR via peroxide-enabled NO oxidation through enhanced oxygen activation, offering a mechanistic basis for rational catalyst design for multipollutant abatement.
articles.title_zh: 甲苯意外 促进低温NO x 减少 通过诱导过氧化氢 铈钛催化剂
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 挥发性有机化合物 (VOC) 被广泛认为通过与 NH3 竞争表面位点和阻塞氧化还原中心来抑制 NH3-SCR，但工业烟气通常同时含有 VOC 和 NOx。在这里，我们发现甲苯出人意料地促进了Ce-Ti催化剂的低温脱硝，空心纳米管结构的CeTiNTs表现出出色的性能，在200°C下实现了>90%的NOx和甲苯转化率，并且具有高CO2选择性和接近一致的N2选择性。从机理上讲，甲苯充当表面 Ce 位点的电子供体，增加了 Ce3+ 分数和与氧空位相关的吸附氧。原位近环境压力 XPS 和拉曼光谱揭示了甲苯触发的表面过氧化物 (O22–) 的形成，这加速了 NO 氧化为 NO2，从而启动快速 SCR 途径，同时实现甲苯的深度氧化。密度泛函理论证实了甲苯在 Ce 位点上的优先吸附以及特定晶格位置处氧空位形成能的降低。这些结果建立了一条反应偶联路线，其中甲苯表现出双重效应，包括部分抑制某些NH3-SCR步骤的竞争吸附，同时通过增强氧活化，通过过氧化物启用的NO氧化主要促进低温快速SCR，为合理的多污染物减排催化剂设计提供了机制基础。

articles.title:
Oxidative Stress
after Pollutant Exposure Depends
Strongly on Experimental Design and Pollutant Properties in Annelids:
A Meta-Analysis
articles.abstract: Abstract Measurements of oxidative stress are often performed to assess a species’ general sublethal stress response to a pollutant. However, oxidative stress bioassays often produce seemingly ambiguous results, and the drivers that lead to these differences are largely unknown. To address this gap, we conducted a meta-analysis on reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, ROS-associated damage products, enzyme activities, and gene expression levels in response to exposures to two groups of pollutants, nano- and microplastic particles (NMP) and neonicotinoid insecticides (neonics). Based on 2294 ROS-related measurements extracted from 45 studies, we show that measured effects vary substantially, with a strong overlap of measured effects with zero. As likely drivers of this variance, we identified multiple parameters of experimental design and pollutant properties. Finally, we performed data simulations and power analyses to investigate how well single experiments are able to detect oxidative stress-related effects. While most oxidative stress markers achieve sufficient power (80%) to demonstrate effects with sample sizes N < 20, conclusions derived from single studies with low sample sizes (N < 5) are at risk of being less informative than previously assumed. Our results highlight the importance of considering pollutant properties, experimental design, and sample size when measuring oxidative stress markers.
articles.title_zh:
氧化应激
污染物暴露后取决于
重点关注环节动物的实验设计和污染物特性：
荟萃分析
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 氧化应激的测量通常用于评估物种对污染物的一般亚致死应激反应。然而，氧化应激生物测定通常会产生看似不明确的结果，而导致这些差异的驱动因素在很大程度上尚不清楚。为了解决这一差距，我们对暴露于纳米和微塑料颗粒 (NMP) 和新烟碱类杀虫剂 (neonics) 两组污染物时的活性氧 (ROS) 生成、ROS 相关损伤产物、酶活性和基因表达水平进行了荟萃分析。基于从 45 项研究中提取的 2294 项 ROS 相关测量结果，我们表明测量的效果差异很大，测量的效果与零有很强的重叠。作为这种差异的可能驱动因素，我们确定了实验设计和污染物特性的多个参数。最后，我们进行了数据模拟和功率分析，以研究单个实验能够如何很好地检测氧化应激相关的影响。虽然大多数氧化应激标记物达到足够的功效（80％）来证明样本量 N < 1 的效果。如图 20 所示，来自小样本量（N < 5）的单项研究得出的结论可能会比之前假设的信息量少。我们的结果强调了在测量氧化应激标记物时考虑污染物特性、实验设计和样本量的重要性。

articles.title:
Enhanced
Pulsed
Electrocatalytic Removal of Fluorinated
Organic Pollutants with Pd Single Atoms and CoP Nanopimples: Synergistic
Degradation by Reduction and Oxidation under Air Conditions
articles.abstract: Abstract To efficiently remove the difficult-to-degrade fluorinated organic pollutants in the aqueous environment, Pd1-CoP@NCu electrodes with both reducing and oxidizing bifunctional activities were constructed in this study, and pulsed electrocatalysis was used to achieve their reducing defluorination and oxidizing degradation under air conditions. In the pulsed mode, a periodic enrichment-release process is formed at the electrode interface. The Eon phase mainly drives the H*-mediated C–F bond breaking and generates reactive oxygen species (ROS) through an oxygen reduction reaction, while the Erest phase triggers the water oxidation process through potential reversal, promotes the continuous generation of a variety of ROS, and facilitates the aromatic ring opening and small-molecule mineralization. The system achieved 99.1% degradation, 62.9% defluorination, and 57.5% TOC removal by using pulsed two-phase synergistic action, effectively completing the defluorination, detoxification, and efficient removal of 4-fluorophenol. Therefore, the design of constructing Pd single-atom synergistic sites and introducing pulsed voltage provides new ideas for developing green, efficient, and sustainable electrochemical remediation technologies for fluorinated pollutants.
articles.title_zh:
增强型
脉冲式
电催化去除氟化物
含有 Pd 单原子和 CoP 纳米颗粒的有机污染物：协同作用
空气条件下的还原和氧化降解
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 为了有效去除水环境中难降解的含氟有机污染物，本研究构建了具有还原和氧化双功能活性的Pd1-CoP@NCu电极，并利用脉冲电催化实现了其在空气条件下的还原脱氟和氧化降解。在脉冲模式下，电极界面处形成周期性的富集-释放过程。 Eon相主要驱动H*介导的C-F键断裂，通过氧还原反应生成活性氧（ROS），而Erest相通过电位反转触发水氧化过程，促进多种ROS的持续生成，有利于芳环开环和小分子矿化。该系统利用脉冲两相协同作用，实现了99.1%的降解、62.9%的脱氟、57.5%的TOC去除，有效完成脱氟、解毒、高效去除4-氟苯酚。因此，构建Pd单原子协同位点并引入脉冲电压的设计为开发绿色、高效、可持续的含氟污染物电化学修复技术提供了新思路。

articles.title:
Understanding
Pulsed Electrolysis Effects in Flow
Cell Architecture for Low-Concentration Pollutants
articles.abstract: Abstract Electrochemical pollutant removal from low-concentration wastewater matrices poses challenges due to the high electrical effort required to overcome inherently low mass transfer rates. Pulsed electrolysis offers a potential solution by adjusting the on and off periods of redox reactions to engineer the rates required for sustained, low-voltage, and consistent removal. Flow cells, industrially relevant configurations, are affected by a multiphysics interaction between fluid and electrolysis mechanisms, unlike batch designs. However, the mass transfer optimization under both electrochemical and flow parameters remains ambiguous. It is essential to understand and optimize pulse parameters such as waveform, duration, and magnitude in relation to flow rates. While cathodic duration and magnitude dictate depletion rate, the corresponding anodic parameters affect the recovery time. Waveform design can smooth the depletion-recovery transition, helping with variable depletion and recovery rates and allowing more engineered pulse responses. While square-wave pulses produce more intense depletion and recovery, sinusoidal waveforms provide a continuously varying current profile that enables more flexible control of surface depletion and recovery In this work, we reveal mechanisms underlying mass transfer behaviors under various flow and pulsing conditions. To support industrial-scale pollutant removal systems, we explore optimization practices and machine learning methods for fit-for-purpose electrolyzer sizing under a pulse pattern optimized for the rapid, energy-efficient pollutant removal.
articles.title_zh:
理解
流动中的脉冲电解效应
适用于低浓度污染物的电池架构
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 由于需要大量电力来克服固有的低传质速率，因此从低浓度废水基质中电化学去除污染物提出了挑战。脉冲电解提供了一种潜在的解决方案，通过调整氧化还原反应的开启和关闭时间来设计持续、低电压和一致去除所需的速率。与批量设计不同，流动池是工业相关的配置，受到流体和电解机制之间的多物理场相互作用的影响。然而，电化学和流动参数下的传质优化仍然不明确。了解和优化脉冲参数（例如波形、持续时间和与流量相关的幅度）至关重要。虽然阴极持续时间和强度决定了耗尽率，但相应的阳极参数影响恢复时间。波形设计可以平滑耗尽-恢复过渡，有助于实现可变的耗尽和恢复率，并允许更多工程化的脉冲响应。虽然方波脉冲产生更强烈的耗尽和恢复，但正弦波形提供连续变化的电流分布，从而能够更灵活地控制表面耗尽和恢复。在这项工作中，我们揭示了各种流动和脉冲条件下传质行为的潜在机制。为了支持工业规模的污染物去除系统，我们探索了优化实践和机器学习方法，以在针对快速、节能的污染物去除而优化的脉冲模式下调整适合用途的电解槽尺寸。

articles.title:
High-Resolution
Spatiotemporal Dynamics of Airborne
eDNA in a Forest Ecosystem
articles.abstract: Abstract Global biodiversity decline necessitates scalable, long-term monitoring systems. Airborne environmental DNA (eDNA) offers a noninvasive approach for multitrophic assessment, but its high spatiotemporal dynamism and low concentrations demand advanced sampling technology. We developed an automated, high-frequency (4 h), multichannel airborne eDNA sampler based on negative-pressure cyclone centrifugation, enabling remote, continuous collection across vertical forest strata. Deploying three samplers across a tropical rainforest canopy gradient (floor, mid-, upper canopy) for 6 days, we obtained 108 samples with DNA yields ranging from 10 to 784 ng per sample. Metabarcoding detected 786 taxa spanning bacteria, fungi, insects, and chordates. Results revealed taxon-specific patterns: bacterial richness peaked during daytime; insects and chordates exhibited clear vertical stratification, with the highest richness in the upper canopy. Time dominated community variation, while insects showed the strongest relative vertical structure. Environmental drivers differed by taxon and scale, with local richness associated mainly with temperature, shortwave radiation, and precipitation, while stronger regional effects (50–100 km) were observed for bacteria, fungi, and insects than for chordates. By resolving fine-grained spatiotemporal dynamics of airborne eDNA, this automated, stratified platform provides an operational framework for long-term terrestrial biodiversity monitoring.
articles.title_zh:
高分辨率
机载时空动力学
森林生态系统中的 eDNA
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 全球生物多样性下降需要可扩展的长期监测系统。空气环境 DNA (eDNA) 为多营养评估提供了一种非侵入性方法，但其高时空动态性和低浓度需要先进的采样技术。我们开发了一种基于负压旋风离心的自动化、高频（4 小时）、多通道机载 eDNA 采样器，可实现跨垂直森林地层的远程、连续采集。我们在热带雨林冠层梯度（地面、中层、上层）上部署三个采样器 6 天，获得了 108 个样本，每个样本的 DNA 产量范围为 10 至 784 ng。元条形码检测到 786 个分类群，涵盖细菌、真菌、昆虫和脊索动物。结果揭示了分类群特异性模式：细菌丰富度在白天达到峰值；昆虫和脊索动物表现出明显的垂直分层，上层冠层的丰富度最高。时间主导群落变化，而昆虫表现出最强的相对垂直结构。环境驱动因素因分类单元和规模而异，局部丰富度主要与温度、短波辐射和降水有关，而细菌、真菌和昆虫的区域效应（50-100公里）比脊索动物更强。通过解决空气中 eDNA 的细粒度时空动态，这个自动化的分层平台为长期陆地生物多样性监测提供了一个操作框架。

articles.title:
A Global LCIA Framework
for Quantifying Seabed Damage
from Bottom Trawling, Dredging, and Benthic Structures
articles.abstract: Abstract The benthic zone provides the foundation for marine ecosystem health, yet seabed damage from anthropogenic activities remains mostly unrepresented in life cycle impact assessment (LCIA). Here, we present a globally applicable LCIA characterization framework for seabed damage from three major disturbance categories: bottom trawling, dredging, and structures on the seabed. We calculate 3,800 characterization factors (CFs) across 231 marine ecoregions (MERs), including 1,900 regional CFs and 1,900 globally normalized CFs derived using global extinction probability (GEP). MER-level CFs are presented for four trawling gear types, dredging, benthic structures, as well as generic-fish and species-level trawling CFs. Species-level CFs for 51 commercially significant fish species are expressed in PDF*yr/kg, which is a functional unit directly usable by practitioners conducting life cycle assessments of seafood and marine industries. The customizable structure of the framework allows practitioners to match assessment precision to available data. Together, these advances strengthen the capacity of LCIA to account for seabed damage across the seafood, energy, and marine infrastructure sectors.
articles.title_zh:
全球 LCIA 框架
用于量化海底损害
来自底拖网、疏浚和底栖结构
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 底栖区为海洋生态系统的健康提供了基础，但人类活动对海底的损害在生命周期影响评估（LCIA）中仍然没有得到体现。在这里，我们提出了一个全球适用的 LCIA 表征框架，用于描述来自三个主要扰动类别的海底损害：海底拖网、疏浚和海底结构。我们计算了 231 个海洋生态区 (MER) 的 3,800 个特征因子 (CF)，其中包括 1,900 个区域 CF 和使用全球灭绝概率 (GEP) 得出的 1,900 个全球标准化 CF。 MER 级 CF 针对四种拖网渔具类型、疏浚、底栖结构以及一般鱼类和物种级拖网捕捞 CF。 51 种具有商业意义的鱼类的物种级 CF 以 PDF*yr/kg 表示，这是对海鲜和海洋产业进行生命周期评估的从业人员可直接使用的功能单位。该框架的可定制结构允许从业者将评估精度与可用数据相匹配。这些进步共同增强了 LCIA 应对海产品、能源和海洋基础设施领域海底损害的能力。

articles.title:
Oxygen-Vacancies-Bridged
Cu2O/Cu Heterojunction
Enables Closed-Loop Electron Cycling for Bidirectional Peracetic Acid
Activation in Fenton-like Reactions
articles.abstract: Abstract Integrating the strong oxidative capacity of radicals with the high selectivity of nonradicals is crucial for efficient pollutant degradation under complex aqueous conditions. However, conventional peroxide activation relies on unidirectional electron utilization, where a single oxidant molecule typically generates only one reactive species, thereby limiting oxidant utilization and electron recycling. Herein, we employ oxygen vacancies (Vo) to bridge asymmetric electronic sites at the Cu2O/Cu heterojunction, achieving bidirectional activation of a single peracetic acid (PAA) within a “closed-loop electron cycle” to simultaneously generate •OH and nonradical active species (NRS). Vo-induced electron delocalization forms continuous electronic levels that facilitate Cu2O→Cu electron transfer, leading to electron enrichment at Cu sites and depletion at Cu2O sites. This electronic asymmetry, coupled with the unoccupied orbitals inherent to Vo, enables a thermodynamically favorable dual-coordination (Cu–(C═Oα) and Cu2O–(Oβ–Oγ), Eads = −3.74 vs −0.79 eV) of a single PAA (CH3–C(Oα)–Oβ–Oγ–H) with Vo–Cu2O/Cu. Driven by the electron-inductive effect, electrons are transferred from Cu to Oβ–Oγ via C═Oα, triggering Oβ–Oγ homolysis to generate •OH and a metastable NRS. The latter extracts electrons from organics via Cu2O to initiate the direct electron-transfer pathway (ETP, ∼46.90%, ΔE = −1.314 eV), thereby achieving a “closed-loop electron cycle”. Unlike conventional unidirectional catalytic pathways, bidirectional activation within a single PAA molecule boosts synchronous enhancement in oxidation-mineralization synergy (∼33-fold increase in k2,O and ∼1.5-fold increase in TOC removal), PAA utilization efficiency (∼1.5-fold increase), and superior resistance to water matrix interference. This previously unrecognized oxidant activation mechanism offers new insights into coupling radical and nonradical pathways via interfacial electron-flow regulation for efficient and energy-saving water remediation.
articles.title_zh:
氧空位桥
Cu2O/Cu异质结
实现双向过乙酸的闭环电子循环
类芬顿反应中的活化
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 将自由基的强氧化能力与非自由基的高选择性相结合对于复杂水条件下污染物的高效降解至关重要。然而，传统的过氧化物活化依赖于单向电子利用，其中单个氧化剂分子通常仅产生一种活性物质，从而限制了氧化剂利用和电子回收。在此，我们利用氧空位（Vo）桥接Cu2O/Cu异质结上的不对称电子位点，实现“闭环电子循环”内单个过乙酸（PAA）的双向激活，同时生成·OH和非自由基活性物质（NRS）。 Vo诱导的电子离域形成连续的电子能级，促进Cu2O→Cu电子转移，导致Cu位点的电子富集和Cu2O位点的耗尽。这种电子不对称性与 Vo 固有的未占据轨道相结合，使得单个 PAA (CH3–C(Oα)–Oβ–Oγ–H) 与 Vo–Cu2O/Cu 形成热力学上有利的双配位（Cu–(C=Oα) 和 Cu2O–(Oβ–Oγ)，Eads = -3.74 vs -0.79 eV）。在电子感应效应的驱动下，电子通过C=Oα从Cu转移到Oβ–Oγ，引发Oβ–Oγ均裂生成·OH和亚稳态NRS。后者通过 Cu2O 从有机物中提取电子，启动直接电子转移途径（ETP，∼46.90%，ΔE = -1.314 eV），从而实现“闭环电子循环”。与传统的单向催化途径不同，单个 PAA 分子内的双向激活可同步增强氧化-矿化协同作用（k2,O 增加约 33 倍，TOC 去除增加约 1.5 倍）、PAA 利用率（增加约 1.5 倍）和卓越的抗水基质干扰能力。这种以前未被认识的氧化剂活化机制为通过界面电子流调节耦合自由基和非自由基途径提供了新的见解，以实现高效节能的水修复。

articles.title:
Bridging Human and
Environmental Radiological Protection
with the Ecosystem Services Approach: A Case Study with Clade Anthophila
(Bees)
articles.abstract: Abstract Ecosystem services, the benefits people derive from nature, provides a conceptual structure by which to explicitly characterize and protect the coupled human–nature relationships that are central to human well-being, the integrity of ecosystems, and sustainable development. We suggest the ecosystem services concept may complement and broaden the International Commission on Radiological Protection’s currently established framework of radiological protection (RP) through intentional reflection on the interconnection between people and their environment. As operationalization of an ecosystem services approach is a notable challenge for implementation, we discuss Anthophila (bees) as a model clade for demonstrating how the ecosystem services approach may contribute to the integrated protection of people and the environment across geographies, cultures, and exposure scenarios. Assessing the impacts of radiological contamination and associated decision-making on ecosystem services has the potential to bridge human and environmental RP through adoption of a sustainable development mindset, enhanced stakeholder engagement, and improved decision-making. We provide a framework to describe how a conceptual model to combine the ecosystem services approach with RP could be helpful in supporting holistic and integrated decision-making in certain situations and demonstrate its application to a hypothetical existing exposure situation using bees as a model clade of species.
articles.title_zh:
架起人与人之间的桥梁
环境放射防护
生态系统服务方法：以 Clade Anthophila 为例
（蜜蜂）
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 生态系统服务是人类从自然中获得的利益，它提供了一个概念结构，通过该结构可以明确描述和保护对人类福祉、生态系统完整性和可持续发展至关重要的人与自然耦合关系。我们建议，通过有意反思人与环境之间的相互关系，生态系统服务概念可以补充和扩大国际放射防护委员会目前建立的放射防护（RP）框架。由于生态系统服务方法的可操作性是实施的一个显着挑战，我们将 Anthophila（蜜蜂）作为一个模型分支来讨论生态系统服务方法如何有助于跨地域、文化和暴露场景的人类和环境的综合保护。评估放射性污染和相关决策对生态系统服务的影响有可能通过采用可持续发展思维、增强利益相关者的参与和改进决策来弥合人类和环境的RP。我们提供了一个框架来描述将生态系统服务方法与 RP 相结合的概念模型如何有助于支持某些情况下的整体和综合决策，并展示其在使用蜜蜂作为物种模型进化枝的假设的现有暴露情况中的应用。

articles.title:
Transport
and Attenuation of Human Viruses in Groundwater:
Assessment of Adsorption-Induced Interfacial Inactivation and Evidence
of Aggregation
articles.abstract: Abstract Virus transport in groundwater is a key pathway contributing to waterborne disease outbreaks and poses significant risks to public health. However, the mechanisms governing virus transport and attenuation remain poorly understood. Here, using the human enteric virus Coxsackievirus (CV-A16), we coupled experiments with a dual-marker approach (TCID50 and RT-qPCR) and a stepwise modeling strategy to quantify virus inactivation, interfacial inactivation, and adsorption during virus transport and attenuation in heterogeneous sediments. Static batch experiments revealed markedly slower CV-A16 inactivation in the aqueous phase, requiring 106–191 days to achieve a 90% loss of infectivity, compared with about 12 days in saturated sediments. Column experiments indicated that kinetic adsorption–desorption was the dominant attenuation mechanism, while surface-associated interfacial inactivation represented an additional important pathway that increased with virus adsorption, reflecting a coupled adsorption-inactivation process. Further analysis showed that inactivation rate constants ranged from 0.002 to 0.004 min–1 from coarse sand to silt, suggesting enhanced virus-solid interface reactivity in finer sediments. Furthermore, bimodal particle-size distributions from laser particle sizing and TEM observations of virus clusters indicate the formation of aggregates during transport, while zeta potential variations suggest that this process most likely occurs during the early to intermediate stages of transport. By evaluating the interplay between physical retention and biological inactivation, this study provides a mechanistic framework to improve the prediction of virus transport and the accuracy of pathogen-related health risk assessments in subsurface environments.
articles.title_zh:
交通
和地下水中人类病毒的减毒：
吸附引起的界面失活的评估和证据
聚合的
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 地下水中的病毒传播是导致水传播疾病爆发的关键途径，并对公众健康构成重大风险。然而，人们对病毒运输和减毒的机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们使用人类肠道病毒柯萨奇病毒（CV-A16），将实验与双标记方法（TCID50和RT-qPCR）和逐步建模策略结合起来，以量化病毒在异质沉积物中运输和减毒过程中的病毒失活、界面失活和吸附。静态批量实验表明，CV-A16 在水相中的灭活速度明显较慢，需要 106-191 天才能实现感染性损失 90%，而在饱和沉积物中则需要约 12 天。柱实验表明，动力学吸附-解吸是主要的衰减机制，而表面相关的界面失活代表了随着病毒吸附而增加的另一个重要途径，反映了吸附-失活的耦合过程。进一步分析表明，从粗砂到淤泥，灭活速率常数范围为 0.002 至 0.004 min-1，这表明较细沉积物中的病毒-固体界面反应性增强。此外，激光粒度测定和病毒簇 TEM 观察得出的双峰粒度分布表明在运输过程中形成了聚集体，而 zeta 电位变化表明该过程最有可能发生在运输的早期到中期阶段。通过评估物理滞留和生物灭活之间的相互作用，本研究提供了一个机制框架，以提高地下环境中病毒传播的预测和病原体相关健康风险评估的准确性。

articles.title:
Intraspecies Variation
of Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl
Substances Bioaccumulation in a Coastal Marine Organism Near a Megacity
articles.abstract: Abstract Intraspecies variation in pollutant bioaccumulation has received limited attention in field studies, which could cause bias for ecological and health risk assessment. In this study, 40 per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) and stable carbon and nitrogen isotope were analyzed in 43 individuals of Cynoglossus trigrammus collected from the coastal area of Shenzhen City, China, to explore the intraspecies variation in PFAS bioaccumulation. Total PFAS (Σ40PFAS) concentrations ranged from 40.0 to 192 ng/g, ww, and increased significantly with body length (p < 0.001). Positive relationships (p < 0.01) were observed for perfluorooctanesulfonate (PFOS), perfluorodecanoic acid (PFDA), perfluoropentanesulfonic acid (PFPeS), and perfluorohexanesulfonic acid (PFHxS), whereas negative relationships (p < 0.05) were observed for perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA), N-methyl perfluorooctanesulfonamidoacetic acid (N-MeFOSE), and 11-Chloroeicosafluoro-3-oxaundecane-1-sulfonic acid (11Cl-PF3OUdS) with body length. Muscle-derived trophic levels also showed significant relationships but were different and weaker than those of body length. Quantile regression showed stronger size effects at high quantiles of whole-fish burden (τ = 0.90 and 0.95), and size-selective feeding (length ≥75th percentile) shifted dose distributions toward higher values. These results suggest that body length is an important indicator to identify the intraspecies PFAS heterogeneity and that size-selective processes might increase upper percentiles exposure and risks.
articles.title_zh:
种内变异
全氟烷基和多氟烷基
大城市附近沿海海洋生物中的物质生物累积
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 污染物生物累积的种内变化在实地研究中受到的关注有限，这可能会导致生态和健康风险评估的偏差。本研究对采自中国深圳市沿海地区的 43 只食蟹猴个体中的 40 种全氟烷基物质和多氟烷基物质 (PFAS) 以及稳定碳和氮同位素进行了分析，以探讨 PFAS 生物累积的种内变化。总 PFAS (Σ40PFAS) 浓度范围为 40.0 至 192 ng/g, ww，并随着体长显着增加 (p < 0.001)。全氟辛烷磺酸 (PFOS)、全氟癸酸 (PFDA)、全氟戊烷磺酸 (PFPeS) 和全氟己烷磺酸 (PFHxS) 呈正相关 (p < 0.01)，而全氟辛酸 (PFOA)、N-甲基全氟辛烷磺酰胺乙酸呈负相关 (p < 0.05) (N-MeFOSE) 和 11-氯二十一氟-3-氧十一烷-1-磺酸 (11Cl-PF3OUdS) 的体长。肌肉来源的营养水平也显示出显着的关系，但与身体长度的关系不同且较弱。分位数回归显示，在全鱼负荷的高分位数（τ = 0.90 和 0.95）下，尺寸效应更强，并且尺寸选择性喂养（长度≥75%）将剂量分布转向更高的值。这些结果表明，体长是识别种内 PFAS 异质性的重要指标，并且体型选择过程可能会增加上百分位数的暴露和风险。

articles.title:
Facilitation-Dominated
Motifs Characterize Cross-Domain
Microbial Networks in Co-Occurring Water and Soil Habitats
articles.abstract: Abstract Microorganisms form complex association networks supporting diverse functions from organic matter decomposition to water quality. However, the prevalence of different network structures (i.e., motifs) and their associations with biodiversity across ecosystems remain poorly understood. We surveyed paired water and soil samples from 20 relatively pristine Tibetan Plateau wetlands, spanning broad climatic and physicochemical gradients. Facilitation-dominated motifs were prevalent in both habitats and positively associated with phylogenetic diversity and species richness across domains; greater positive association prevalence among archaea, bacteria, and eukaryotes likewise correlated with greater biodiversity. These patterns were robust to alternative edge-retention thresholds, abundance table null models, and networks reconstructed from centered log-ratio-transformed or presence/absence data. Facilitation-dominated motifs were most consistently associated with network size- and centralization-related properties, whereas their associations with cohesion- and stability-related properties were more habitat-dependent and were clearer in soil than in water. The cycle facilitation motif, with all three pairwise associations positive, showed the most consistent associations with biodiversity and network properties. Structural equation modeling suggested links between environmental factors and biodiversity through paths involving the motif overrepresentation. Overall, facilitation-dominated co-occurrence structures were consistently associated with biodiversity in water and soil habitats, highlighting the microbial association structure as a useful framework for interpreting wetland biodiversity patterns.
articles.title_zh:
以便利为主
主题表征跨领域
水和土壤共存生境中的微生物网络
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 微生物形成复杂的关联网络，支持从有机物分解到水质的多种功能。然而，不同网络结构（即主题）的普遍性及其与跨生态系统生物多样性的关联仍然知之甚少。我们调查了来自 20 个相对原始的青藏高原湿地的配对水和土壤样本，涵盖了广泛的气候和物理化学梯度。促进主导的主题在这两个栖息地中都很普遍，并且与跨领域的系统发育多样性和物种丰富度呈正相关；古细菌、细菌和真核生物之间更大的正相关流行率同样与更大的生物多样性相关。这些模式对于替代边缘保留阈值、丰度表空模型以及从中心对数比转换或存在/不存在数据重建的网络来说是稳健的。促进主导的主题与网络规模和集中度相关的特性最为一致，而它们与内聚力和稳定性相关特性的关联则更多地依赖于栖息地，并且在土壤中比在水中更清晰。循环促进主题，所有三个成对关联均为正，显示出与生物多样性和网络特性最一致的关联。结构方程模型通过涉及主题过度表达的路径表明环境因素与生物多样性之间的联系。总体而言，促进主导的共现结构始终与水和土壤栖息地的生物多样性相关，强调微生物关联结构是解释湿地生物多样性模式的有用框架。

articles.title:
Zebrafish Serotonin
Transporter Inhibition Enables
Identification of Neuroactive Chemicals: Structural Insights into
Interspecies Differences
articles.abstract: Abstract Antidepressants are widely detected in aquatic environments and can affect fish behavior through inhibition of the serotonin transporter (SERT). Notably, zebrafish SERT (zSERT) exhibits greater sensitivity to antidepressants than human SERT (hSERT), suggesting species-specific differences in transporter structures. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying this differential inhibition remain elusive, and prioritized antidepressants alone cannot fully explain the zSERT-mediated activity observed in the environmental samples. Herein, molecular simulation, computational screening, and experimental validation were adopted to identify environmental chemicals with potential activity toward zSERT. The binding affinity of 27 antidepressants for hSERT and zSERT was predicted by Boltz-2. The antidepressant with the largest interspecies difference was selected as a representative case, and the key amino acid residues involved in binding were characterized by using molecular dynamics simulations performed for at least 100 ns. The molecular simulation-optimized zSERT structure was then applied in structure-based virtual screening to identify potentially toxic compounds from a chemical library comprising high-risk chemicals from Europe and China. Fourteen of the 15 top-ranked candidates were found to inhibit zSERT in an in vitro assay. This integrative approach provides a mechanistically informed framework for identifying previously unrecognized zSERT-acting chemicals and improving hazard identification and cross-species risk assessments in aquatic environments.
articles.title_zh:
斑马鱼血清素
转运蛋白抑制使
Identification of Neuroactive Chemicals: Structural Insights into
种间差异
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 抗抑郁药在水生环境中广泛存在，可通过抑制血清素转运蛋白 (SERT) 影响鱼类行为。值得注意的是，斑马鱼 SERT (zSERT) 比人类 SERT (hSERT) 对抗抑郁药表现出更高的敏感性，这表明转运蛋白结构存在物种特异性差异。然而，这种差异抑制背后的分子机制仍然难以捉摸，并且单独优先的抗抑郁药无法完全解释在环境样本中观察到的 zSERT 介导的活性。在此，采用分子模拟、计算筛选和实验验证来识别对 zSERT 具有潜在活性的环境化学物质。 The binding affinity of 27 antidepressants for hSERT and zSERT was predicted by Boltz-2.选择种间差异最大的抗抑郁药作为代表案例，并通过至少100 ns的分子动力学模拟来表征参与结合的关键氨基酸残基。然后将分子模拟优化的 zSERT 结构应用于基于结构的虚拟筛选，以从包含来自欧洲和中国的高风险化学品的化学库中识别潜在有毒化合物。 Fourteen of the 15 top-ranked candidates were found to inhibit zSERT in an in vitro assay.这种综合方法提供了一个机械化的框架，用于识别以前未被识别的 zSERT 作用化学品，并改进水生环境中的危害识别和跨物种风险评估。

articles.title:
Carbonyl Index Variability
and Trends in Marine Meso-Microplastics:
Implications of Instrumental Effects and Spectral Preprocessing
articles.abstract: Abstract This study addresses the critical need to understand variability in the carbonyl index (CI) of marine plastics to effectively assess their environmental fate. Standardization is essential to ensure data interoperability and comparability across different research laboratories. We evaluated the effect of spectral preprocessing on the comparability of four carbonyl indices derived from analyses of marine meso- and microplastics across three ATR-FTIR instruments. The fillpeaks baseline spectral preprocessing correction yielded the highest consistency and interlaboratory correlation, thus supporting its adoption as a standard for environmental CI determination. Moreover, when used with the CI-SAUB index, defined as the ratio of the carbonyl peak area to the methylene peak area, instrumental differences are effectively smoothed out. We also demonstrated that index-specific CI values derived from spectra processed differently are not directly comparable, further underscoring the need for harmonized protocols. Our analysis supports the use of the CI as a reliable proxy for surface oxidation resulting from weathering mechanisms. To enhance reproducibility in future research, we provide a cross-validated, open-access spectral library of weathered plastics, along with a reference database for estimating the CI of weathered particles. Our results emphasize the importance of standardized approaches for improving the reliability and reproducibility of plastic pollution research and monitoring.
articles.title_zh:
羰基指数变异性
海洋细观微塑料的发展趋势：
仪器效应和光谱预处理的意义
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 这项研究解决了了解海洋塑料羰基指数 (CI) 变化的迫切需要，以有效评估其环境命运。标准化对于确保不同研究实验室之间的数据互操作性和可比性至关重要。我们评估了光谱预处理对四个羰基指数可比性的影响，这四个羰基指数是通过三台 ATR-FTIR 仪器对海洋细观塑料和微塑料进行分析得出的。 fillpeaks 基线光谱预处理校正产生了最高的一致性和实验室间相关性，从而支持其采用作为环境 CI 测定的标准。此外，当与 CI-SAUB 指数（定义为羰基峰面积与亚甲基峰面积之比）一起使用时，可以有效消除仪器差异。我们还证明，从不同处理的光谱中得出的特定指数 CI 值不能直接比较，这进一步强调了协调协议的必要性。我们的分析支持使用 CI 作为风化机制导致的表面氧化的可靠指标。为了提高未来研究的可重复性，我们提供了一个经过交叉验证、开放获取的风化塑料光谱库，以及用于估计风化颗粒 CI 的参考数据库。我们的结果强调了标准化方法对于提高塑料污染研究和监测的可靠性和可重复性的重要性。

articles.title:
Monovalent
Ion Selectivity
Incomparability of Graphene
Oxide Membrane in Different Separation Systems: A Microscopic Understanding
articles.abstract: Abstract Precise monovalent ion sieving is essential for water treatment and resource recovery. However, ion selectivity reported from diffusion-based and electro-driven membrane processes is often inconsistent and difficult to reconcile due to unclear mechanistic understanding. Herein, combining experiments with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, we reveal divergent microscopic mechanisms governing monovalent ion selectivity in graphene oxide (GO) nanochannels under different driving forces. Under concentration gradient-driven diffusion, ion selectivity is predominantly regulated by hydration-mediated effects (i.e., partial ion dehydration and dehydration-induced ion–membrane interactions) and cation–anion interaction. Specifically, in simulated defect-free GO nanochannel, Li+, with higher hydration energy and charge density than Na+, possesses a more intact hydration shell and stronger cation–anion interaction, which limit partitioning but reduce transport resistance, resulting in a Li+/Na+ selectivity of 3.3. Conversely, under electric field-driven electromigration, a reversed selectivity (Li+/Na+ = 0.4) occurs due to enhanced cation–anion associations, where stronger Li+–Cl– pairing suppresses both cation partitioning and mobility, generating ion association-dominated selectivity. These results demonstrate that ion selectivity is not an intrinsic membrane property but is strongly governed by the driving-force-dependent transport mechanism. This study resolves the long-standing incomparability in ion selectivity across different separation systems and provides mechanistic guidance for designing next-generation membranes with tailored ion selectivity.
articles.title_zh:
单价
离子选择性
石墨烯无可比拟
不同分离系统中的氧化物膜：微观理解
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 精确的单价离子筛分对于水处理和资源回收至关重要。然而，由于对机理的理解不明确，基于扩散和电驱动的膜过程报告的离子选择性通常不一致并且难以协调。在此，结合实验与分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们揭示了在不同驱动力下控制氧化石墨烯（GO）纳米通道中单价离子选择性的不同微观机制。在浓度梯度驱动的扩散下，离子选择性主要受水合介导效应（即部分离子脱水和脱水诱导的离子膜相互作用）和阳离子阴离子相互作用的调节。具体来说，在模拟的无缺陷GO纳米通道中，Li+比Na+具有更高的水合能和电荷密度，拥有更完整的水合壳和更强的阳离子-阴离子相互作用，这限制了分配但降低了传输阻力，导致Li+/Na+选择性为3.3。相反，在电场驱动的电迁移下，由于阳离子-阴离子缔合增强，出现反向选择性（Li+/Na+ = 0.4），其中更强的Li+-Cl-配对抑制阳离子分配和迁移率，产生离子缔合主导的选择性。这些结果表明，离子选择性不是固有的膜特性，而是受到驱动力依赖的传输机制的强烈控制。这项研究解决了不同分离系统之间离子选择性长期存在的不可比性，并为设计具有定制离子选择性的下一代膜提供了机械指导。

articles.title:
Safeguarding Cost-Effective
and Risk-Mitigated Chemical
Decarbonization by Diversified Energy Supply
articles.abstract: Abstract Wind and solar power are widely regarded as the primary energy sources for chemical decarbonization, yet their spatial mismatch with production hubs poses inherent challenges. Locally available hydropower, nuclear power, and biomass offer promising alternatives. Using a spatially explicit model with endogenous optimization of industrial spatial configuration, we show that diversified energy supply safeguards cost-effective and risk-mitigated chemical decarbonization in China, compared to the prevailing wind–solar-dominated strategies. By 2060, the annualized cost of chemical sector is reduced by 218 billion CNY (0.22% of China’s 2020 GDP), and the marginal abatement cost declines from 3160 to 1401 CNY/t, making net-zero emissions more economically feasible. Deployment requirements for critical-metal-intensive electrolyzers and energy storage technologies decline by 46.5% and 63.7%, respectively, and the still-immature direct air capture with utilization becomes largely unnecessary. Moreover, the potential stranded coal-based chemical capacity declines from 16.9 GW to 1.55 GW, and the chemical-sector contractions in Henan, Guizhou, and Chongqing are avoided, primarily through biomass-based methanol expansion. We caution against overly optimistic wind–solar-dominated strategies and advocate regionally tailored transitions.
articles.title_zh:
保障成本效益
和降低风险的化学品
多元化能源供应脱碳
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 风能和太阳能被广泛认为是化学脱碳的主要能源，但它们与生产中心的空间不匹配带来了固有的挑战。当地可用的水电、核电和生物质能提供了有前景的替代方案。使用具有产业空间配置内生优化的空间显式模型，我们表明，与现行的风能-太阳能主导战略相比，多元化的能源供应保障了中国化学脱碳的成本效益和风险降低。到2060年，化工行业年化成本降低2180亿元人民币（占中国2020年GDP的0.22%），边际减排成本从3160元/吨下降到1401元/吨，净零排放在经济上更加可行。关键金属密集型电解槽和储能技术的部署要求分别下降了46.5%和63.7%，而尚不成熟的直接空气捕获和利用在很大程度上变得没有必要。此外，潜在搁浅的煤化工产能从16.9吉瓦下降至1.55吉瓦，主要通过生物质甲醇扩张避免了河南、贵州和重庆的化工行业收缩。我们警告不要过于乐观的风能-太阳能主导战略，并提倡针对区域进行量身定制的转型。

articles.title: Uncovering tert -Butylphenols as New Precursors of 2,4,6-Trichlorophenol in Chlorinated Drinking Water
articles.abstract: Abstract 2,4,6-Trichlorophenol is a well-known carcinogen, aromatic disinfection byproduct (DBP), and anthropogenic contaminant in drinking water, with a high detection frequency and concentration. Natural organic matter (NOM) is considered as its key precursor; however, the formation potential of NOM to 2,4,6-trichlorophenol during chlorination does not explain the μg/L levels observed in disinfected drinking water. In this study, concentrations of 2,4,6-trichlorophenol in drinking water from South Carolina were determined, and important new tert-butylphenol precursors were identified using nontarget and suspect screening analysis with gas chromatography (GC)-mass spectrometry (MS). Concentrations of 2,4,6-trichlorophenol in 12 chlorinated and chloraminated drinking water samples ranged from 9 to 14,966 ng/L (mean: 4805 ng/L), higher than 11 other classes of aromatic DBPs and 4 classes of aliphatic DBPs. During chlorination, yields of 2,4,6-trichlorophenol from Suwannee River NOM were 22 ng/mg-total organic carbon (TOC). In contrast, 2-tert-butylphenol, 4-tert-butylphenol, 2,4-di-tert-butylphenol, and 2,6-di-tert-butylphenol, found up to 41,037 ng/L in river water as industrial contaminants, showed yields of 737, 711, 1261, and 2939 ng/mg-TOC, respectively. tert-Butylphenols in source water contributed ∼3% of 2,4,6-trichlorophenol in the studied chlorinated river waters. Formation mechanisms were proposed. This study provides insight into uncovering additional unknown precursors of chlorophenols.
articles.title_zh: 揭秘 叔 - 丁基苯酚作为新产品 氯化饮用水中 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的前体
articles.abstract_zh: 摘要 2,4,6-三氯苯酚是众所周知的致癌物、芳香族消毒副产物（DBP）和饮用水中的人为污染物，检测频率和浓度很高。天然有机质（NOM）被认为是其关键前体；然而，氯化过程中 NOM 形成 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的可能性并不能解释消毒饮用水中观察到的 μg/L 水平。在这项研究中，测定了南卡罗来纳州饮用水中 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的浓度，并通过气相色谱 (GC)-质谱 (MS) 进行非目标和可疑筛选分析，鉴定了重要的新型叔丁基苯酚前体。 12 个氯化和氯胺化饮用水样品中 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的浓度范围为 9 至 14,966 ng/L（平均值：4805 ng/L），高于其他 11 类芳香族 DBP 和 4 类脂肪族 DBP。在氯化过程中，Suwannee River NOM 中 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的产量为 22 ng/mg 总有机碳 (TOC)。相比之下，河水中工业污染物 2-叔丁基苯酚、4-叔丁基苯酚、2,4-二叔丁基苯酚和 2,6-二叔丁基苯酚的含量高达 41,037 ng/L，其 TOC 产量分别为 737、711、1261 和 2939 ng/mg-TOC。在所研究的氯化河水中，源水中的叔丁基苯酚占 2,4,6-三氯苯酚的 3%。提出了形成机制。这项研究为揭示其他未知的氯酚前体提供了见解。
